译者：柳下杜拉罕

原种：龙田凤
PANICULATA var. PANICULATA Gray, 1852.Synonyms:
异名：
Cotyledon greyi Baker (1869) / Echeveria greyi (Baker) Morren (1874)Series Thyrsiflorae
聚伞圆锥花序系Distribution: Mexico (Chihuahua, Durango, Zacatecas)
地理分布：墨西哥（奇瓦瓦州，Durango州, Zacatecas州）Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述：（根据2003年IHSP）Roots fusiform, fleshy.
根纺锤形，肉质。Stem nearly lacking, rarely branching.
几乎没有茎，少分枝。Rosette ± 10 – 12 cm in diameter.
莲座直径± 10 -12厘米Leaves spreading horizontally, oblanceolate, acuminate, ± 10 x 3 cm, rather thin, green.
叶片水平张开，倒披针形，渐尖，±10×3厘米，微薄，绿色。Inflorescences cymose-paniculate, branches 6 – 8, each with 1 – 6 flowers, pedicels short.
花序为聚伞状圆锥花序，分枝6–8，每支花茎生有1–6花，花梗短。Flowers: Sepals more ascending than in var. maculata, to 10 mm, corolla ± 12 x 9 mm in diameter near the base, reddish-yellow near the base, yellow above.
花：萼片比其变种var. maculata更长，约10毫米，花冠近基部，直径±12 x 9毫米，基部红黄色，上面黄色。Cytology : n = 28
染色体：n=28

Photos Mieke Geuens

E. paniculata, Durango, Mazatlan
Photos Emmanuelle Aubé

变种：
PANICULATA var. MACULATA (Rose) Kimnach 1998.Synonyms:
异名：
Echeveria maculata Rose (1903)
Echeveria longipes E. Walther (1935)Series Thyrsiflorae
聚伞圆锥花序系Distribution: Mexico (Hidalgo, Querétero, Michoacán, San Luis Potosí, Zacatecas, Jalisco).
地理分布：墨西哥（Hidalgo, Querétero, Michoacán, San Luis Potosí, Zacatecas, Jalisco）Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）Differs from var. paniculata :
不同于原种 龙田凤：Leaves narrowly rhomboid-oblanceolate, 7 – 10 x 1,5 – 2,5 cm, rather thick and more succulent.
叶片狭菱形倒披针形，7-10×1.5-2.5厘米，相当厚，肉质。Inflorescences thyrses, either subpaniculate below and spicate-racemose above or with numerous, mostly 2-flowered branchlets, pedicels 1 – 2 (-16) mm.
花序为聚伞圆锥花序，既不及圆锥花序同时又超过穗状的总状花序，或者带有大量的大多生有2花的小枝，花梗1–2（16）毫米。Flowers : Sepals widely expanding, to 8 mm, corolla ± 16 x 9 mm in diameter near the base, yellow.
花：萼片普遍平展，8毫米，花冠直径±16 x 9毫米，近基部，黄色。Cytology : n = 28
染色体：n=28

Echeveria paniculata var.maculata, Quiroga.
Photo Emmanuelle Aubé
